title: Opponent moves your ball in match play
question: In match play, your opponent accidentally moves your ball while searching for it in the rough. What is the correct procedure?

choices.text: Your opponent gets a penalty and the ball is replaced
No penalty for anyone, and the ball must be replaced
The ball is played from its new position
You get a penalty and must replace the ball

explanation: In match play, if your opponent moves your ball accidentally during a search, no one is penalised but the ball must be put back where it was.
